headline_item.title_zh: Perplexity推出Monitor API支持自动化实时监控
headline_item.title_en: Perplexity's new Monitor API turns web search from a one-off query into a nonstop watchdog
headline_item.event_summary_zh: Perplexity发布Monitor API，通过自定义自然语言目标实现对全网及特定页面的自动化监控与智能筛选更新
headline_item.event_summary_en: Perplexity has launched the Monitor API, allowing developers to define monitoring goals via natural language for periodic scanning of specific web pages or global information. The service integrates a decision model to filter out noise, pushing verified updates via webhooks only when findings meet predefined criteria for relevance, credibility, and novelty.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】困惑人工智能在企业开发者生态平台：发布Monitor API，支持全网查询监控与特定页面变更监测
【起因与机理】解决工程团队自行维护重复搜索代码及处理噪声信息的工程负担
【关键技术规格】企业级API通过自然语言定义任务，替代传统重复性爬虫代码。
【各方立场与态度】支持全网监控与特定URL变更比对，直接对标Firecrawl等存量市场玩家。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Perplexity AI (Enterprise developer ecosystem): Launch of Monitor API for web search and page change monitoring
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To alleviate the engineering overhead of building custom recurring search pipelines and noise reduction logic
[Key Metrics] Web monitors cost $1 per 1,000 successful runs, and page monitors cost $1 per 1,000 fetched URLs.
[Scope & Next Steps] Features include global search monitoring and targeted URL diffing to compete with incumbents like Firecrawl.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: Perplexity通过将底层搜索聚合能力封装为实时智能代理（Agentic）接口，试图从单纯的问答工具转型为企业的自动化情报基建。此举不仅对传统抓取服务供应商形成降维打击，更通过引入决策模型过滤层，进一步确立了其在AI应用链条中作为智能中枢的技术壁垒。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: By encapsulating search aggregation into agentic APIs, Perplexity is pivoting from a consumer Q&A tool to a critical automation infrastructure. This move disrupts traditional scraping services and establishes a competitive moat by positioning itself as the intelligent middleware within the AI agentic workflow.

headlines.title_zh: 大模型“意念编程”开启消费电子硬件破解潮
headlines.title_en: The vibe-coding revolution is coming to all the gadgets
headlines.event_summary_zh: 开发者利用Claude Code等AI工具简化硬件底层代码交互，Android设备的非官方界面定制与功能解锁正加速普及
headlines.event_summary_en: A new wave of hardware customization, termed 'vibe-coding,' is emerging as developers utilize large language models like Claude Code and Codex to simplify low-level hardware configuration. By automating interactions such as modifying Android TV interfaces and bypassing bloatware via USB debugging, this trend is significantly lowering the barrier for end-user control over proprietary hardware, fueling a grassroots movement for open-device ecosystems.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】软件开发者（以Gathin T为代表）及Claude Code用户：利用AI模型简化底层代码交互，实现系统广告屏蔽与界面定制化重构
【起因与机理】AI极大地降低了硬件逆向工程与系统调整的技术门槛，增强了消费者对设备的实际掌控权
【关键技术规格】AI模型大幅降低了硬件底层配置与修改的技术门槛。
【各方立场与态度】消费电子市场将面临从单一控制权向用户自定义权力的生态演变。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Software developers (e.g., Gathin T) and Claude Code users: Using AI models to simplify low-level coding interactions for ad-blocking and UI restructuring
[Root Cause & Mechanism] AI lowers the barrier for hardware reverse engineering and customization, empowering consumer device autonomy
[Key Technical Spec] AI models significantly reduce technical barriers for low-level hardware configuration and modification.
[Key Position & Outlook] Consumer electronics markets face a shift from proprietary control to user-driven customization.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: AI赋能的底层代码交互实际上是对消费电子“黑盒化”商业模式的降维打击。当LLM使得逆向工程和固件修补不再依赖专业知识时，厂商通过封锁系统API维护护城河的策略将失效，迫使硬件生态必须转向更开放的软件服务竞争，否则将面临大规模的用户端“去中心化”改造挑战。
headlines.industry_impact_en: AI-empowered low-level coding effectively disrupts the 'black box' business model of consumer electronics. As LLMs lower the barriers to reverse engineering, vendor strategies that lock system APIs to maintain moats will become obsolete, forcing a shift towards open ecosystem competition to prevent widespread user-led decentralization of proprietary systems.

headlines.title_zh: AI推理平台安全漏洞致用户密钥遭大规模窃取
headlines.title_en: Security researchers show how cheap AI inference providers steal keys and snoop on users
headlines.event_summary_zh: 安全机构Dragos通过模拟测试发现，多家AI推理代理商存在严重的隐私泄露与密钥窃取漏洞，导致用户凭证遭到非法访问与持久化攻击
headlines.event_summary_en: Security firm Dragos revealed between July and November 2026 that multiple AI inference providers failed to uphold data retention policies, leading to the theft of AWS keys and sensitive user requests. Investigations confirmed that some marketplace resellers enabled logging to intercept data, with instances of leaked test URLs being accessed within minutes from Beijing and Shanghai via internal communication platforms.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】安全机构Dragos、AI路由服务商OpenRouter、推理平台Novita、Phala、Together及部分未公开第三方在全球性AI模型推理调用API接口及在线算力市场：通过向代理商投喂诱饵数据，揭露了攻击者窃取API密钥、滥用零数据留存政策以及利用内部日志泄露敏感信息的行为
【起因与机理】AI推理市场缺乏统一的端到端加密与安全合规标准，中间商为压低价格牺牲了数据隔离与安全合规性
【关键数据与实测】关键时间节点与后续：OpenRouter已紧急移除违规供应商并撤销125个终端的ZDR认证，受影响厂商正陆续发布初步安全报告。
【涉及范围与推进】核心涉案与合规细节：包括Novita、Phala及Together在内的多家服务商被指出无视“零数据留存”承诺，且存在长期的凭证日志残留。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Dragos (security researchers), OpenRouter, inference providers like Novita, Phala, and Together: Exposure of widespread API key theft, violation of 'Zero Data Retention' (ZDR) policies, and exploitation of internal logging mechanisms
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Lack of standardized end-to-end encryption in the fragmented AI inference supply chain and excessive cost-cutting by marketplace resellers
[Regulatory & Investigation Focus] Core Investigation & Findings: Dragos identified systemic data interception and credential theft, urging stricter oversight of AI middleware providers.
[Key Position & Outlook] Outlook & Timeline: OpenRouter removed non-compliant providers and revoked 125 ZDR certifications, with affected firms currently issuing security remediations.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: AI中间层市场的“低价优先”竞价机制已演变为供应链的严重安全漏洞，使得推理过程中的数据合规协议（如ZDR）完全失效。企业必须重新评估AI API调用的信任边界，由单纯依赖服务商承诺转向强化边缘端的加密分片处理，以应对中间代理商带来的零信任挑战。
headlines.industry_impact_en: The 'lowest-price-wins' competition in AI inference marketplaces has become a critical supply chain vulnerability, rendering data privacy protocols like ZDR essentially decorative. Enterprises must shift from trusting service provider policies toward implementing end-to-end, edge-based encryption to mitigate the inherent trust risks of multi-hop API routing.

titans.quote_zh:
第一个块讲述了关于 @Hypesium 的更大故事，而不是简单的速度基准。

Elysium 以 100 毫秒的区块间隔运行，没有公共内存池。这改变了应用程序处理事务准备的方式。在传统的工作流程中，机会出现后可能会发生多个操作。在 Elysium 上，提前移动该工作成为一个重要的架构决策。

Hypesium 描述了一种准备优先的执行模型：

➜ 交易路径是提前构建的。
➜ Calldata 在池事件之前准备好。
➜ 气体信息被刷新。
➜ 维持钱包随机数状态。
➜ 池创建日志触发提交过程。

记录的热路径目标为 5 毫秒以下，并使用四个通信通道同时提交。

我发现有趣的是块时序和软件架构之间的关系。 100 毫秒的区块间隔不仅仅奖励更快的计算机。它还奖励那些最大限度地减少最后时刻剩余工作量的系统。

交易提交、区块包含和最终确认之间仍然存在区别。这些绝不应该被视为相同的性能测量。

@Hypesium 的架构提供了一个有趣的案例研究，将计算从时间敏感的执行窗口中移开。

真正的工程问题不仅仅是系统的反应速度有多快，而是在做出反应之前它完成了多少准备工作。
titans.quote_en:
The first block tells a bigger story about @Hypesium than a simple speed benchmark.

Elysium operates with 100ms block intervals and no public mempool. That changes the way applications need to approach transaction preparation. In a conventional workflow, several operations may happen after an opportunity appears. On Elysium, moving that work earlier becomes an important architectural decision.

Hypesium describes a preparation-first execution model:

➜ The transaction route is constructed in advance.
➜ Calldata is prepared before the pool event.
➜ Gas information is refreshed.
➜ Wallet nonce state is maintained.
➜ The pool creation log triggers the submission process.

The documented hot path targets under 5ms, with four communication lanes used for simultaneous submission.

What I find interesting is the relationship between block timing and software architecture. A 100ms block interval doesn't simply reward faster computers. It also rewards systems that minimize the amount of work left for the final moment.

There is still a distinction between transaction submission, block inclusion and final confirmation. These should never be treated as identical performance measurements.

@Hypesium's architecture offers an interesting case study in moving computation away from a time-sensitive execution window.

The real engineering question is not just how quickly a system reacts, but how much preparation it completes before there is anything to react to.

划先于代码。

失败的测试先于修复。

每个更改都会由尚未了解其编写方式的上下文进行审查。

→ 规划：你给它一个句子并在一行出现之前批准该计划
→ 审阅：每种语言都有不同的审阅者，从头开始读取您的差异
→ 构建修复：每个工具链都有一个修复程序，包括 PyTorch 和 CUDA
→ 安全性：代理配置中的完整 OWASP 扫描和注入扫描
→ 架构：在迁移之前检测设计错误，当它们仍然便宜时
→ 领域：数据库、ML 管道、E2E 测试和文档

安全部分几乎没有人设置。

外部 OWASP 审核的费用为四位数和一周。这个在你吃之前已经准备好了。

这些技能涵盖测试、Python、Go、Rust、Django、Next.js、Docker 和 CI/CD。

也就是说，不要一次激活所有 286 个，否则您最终会得到一个比您原来的配置更糟糕的配置。

这是它很好地集成的方式：

→ 在复制任何内容之前创建一个 fork 并阅读 README
→ 仅从规划代理和您的主要语言的规则包开始
→ 仅将本周要使用的代理和技能复制到您的 .claude 文件夹
→ 随后添加代码审查人员和安全人员，因为它们产出最多
→ 首先在一个小型仓库上进行测试，而不是在生产环境中进行测试
→ 如果有多余的东西，就把它剪掉。如果您遗漏了什么，请再添加一件

规则很简单：如果您不知道代理的用途，那么您还不需要它。

谁在这个周末整合得好，谁就会在下个季度回顾工作而不是编写工作。

ANTHROPIC 官方黑客马拉松的获胜者已经发布了他的 Claude Code 设置，并且它是纯金的

68 个子代理、286 种技能、94 条命令、MIT 许可证。

ECC 将 Claude Code 打造为一支完整的工程团队。

计划先于代码。

失败的测试先于修复。

每个更改都会由尚未了解其编写方式的上下文进行审查。

→ 规划：你给它一个句子并在一行出现之前批准该计划
→ 审阅：每种语言都有不同的审阅者，从头开始读取您的差异
→ 构建修复：每个工具链都有一个修复程序，包括 PyTorch 和 CUDA
→ 安全性：代理配置中的完整 OWASP 扫描和注入扫描
→ 架构：在迁移之前检测设计错误，当它们仍然便宜时
→ 领域：数据库、ML 管道、E2E 测试和文档

安全部分几乎没有人设置。

外部 OWASP 审核的费用为四位数和一周。这个在你吃之前已经准备好了。

这些技能涵盖测试、Python、Go、Rust、Django、Next.js、Docker 和 CI/CD。

也就是说，不要一次激活所有 286 个，否则您最终会得到一个比您原来的配置更糟糕的配置。

这是它很好地集成的方式：

→ 在复制任何内容之前创建一个 fork 并阅读 README
→ 仅从规划代理和您的主要语言的规则包开始
→ 仅将本周要使用的代理和技能复制到您的 .claude 文件夹
→ 随后添加代码审查人员和安全人员，因为它们产出最多
→ 首先在一个小型仓库上进行测试，而不是在生产环境中进行测试
→ 如果有多余的东西，就把它剪掉。如果您遗漏了什么，请再添加一件

规则很简单：如果您不知道代理的用途，那么您还不需要它。

谁在这个周末整合得好，谁就会在下个季度回顾工作而不是编写工作。

保存这篇文章，你会感谢我的🔖
titans.quote_en:
THE WINNER OF ANTHROPIC'S OFFICIAL HACKATHON HAS PUBLISHED HIS CLAUDE CODE SETUP AND IT'S PURE GOLD

68 subagents, 286 skills, 94 commands, MIT license.

ECC turns Claude Code into a full engineering team.

The plan comes before the code.

The failing test comes before the fix.

Every change is reviewed by a context that hasn't seen how it was written.

→ Planning: you give it a sentence and approve the plan before a single line exists  
→ Review: a different reviewer per language that reads your diff from scratch  
→ Build fixes: a fixer per toolchain, including PyTorch and CUDA  
→ Security: full OWASP sweep and injection scanning in the agent config  
→ Architecture: detects design errors when they're still cheap, before migration  
→ Domain: databases, ML pipelines, E2E tests, and documentation

The security part is what almost nobody sets up.

An external OWASP audit costs four figures and a week. This one is ready before you eat.

The skills cover testing, Python, Go, Rust, Django, Next.js, Docker, and CI/CD.

That said, don't activate all 286 at once or you'll end up with a config worse than the one you had.

This is how it integrates well:

→ Make a fork and read the README before copying anything  
→ Start only with the planning agent and the rules pack for your main language  
→ Copy to your .claude folder only the agents and skills you're going to use this week  
→ Add the code reviewer and the security one afterward, as they yield the most  
→ Test it first on a small repo, not in production  
→ If something's extra, cut it. If you miss something, add just one more piece

The rule is simple: if you don't know what an agent is for, you don't need it yet.

Whoever integrates it well this weekend will spend the next quarter reviewing work instead of writing it.

Save this post, you'll thank me 🔖
